name: Крупные обломки — ступенчатая плита
subject: ONE destructible natural gray rock resource asset, angular stepped fused voxel geology, warm-gray primary stone with a few pale coarse mineral patches, dark-gray wide fracture seams and restrained FLAT olive moss color patches attached to stone surfaces (no growing plants). Large Minecraft-style cubic masses with chunky material pixels, no tiny rubble confetti, smooth beveled stone or photoreal texture. No soil, ground, grass, pedestal or landscape. This is ONE variant, not a family gallery or destruction sequence. All five copies show the same arrangement of main masses, cracks and separate fragments. Second destruction-stage broken large rock. A broad broken stepped slab core with THREE major offset stone terraces and two substantial detached side blocks nearby; wide fresh fracture planes, medium-height mass spread horizontally. Detached blocks remain same positions in every view.
caption: Один вариант соответствующей стадии разрушения: пять ракурсов без земли, ландшафта и подписи.
